jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT TESSERA LABS Tessera Labs is a new category of enterprise software: an AI platform that changes how the world's largest companies run. Every large enterprise carries the same weight — decades of accumulated process, data, and code that no longer match the business it has become. Changing any of it is a program measured in years and hundreds of millions of dollars, staffed by armies of consultants, and it fails more often than anyone admits. Most companies have quietly accepted this as the cost of being large. We don't. Tessera is a transformation engine: a governed, multi-agent platform that understands an enterprise's process, data, and code as one connected system and changes it in weeks rather than years. We're vendor-agnostic by design — SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Oracle, Snowflake, MuleSoft — and tied to none of them. Two things make this hard, and they're the reason the job is interesting. Governance: every action is logged, traceable, and reversible, because our customers are regulated and these are the systems that close their books. And generality: the platform has to work on landscapes it has never seen, at companies whose complexity is genuinely unique to them. We sell a product, not a service. Our people are here to make the product successful, not the other way around. If you've watched enterprise AI companies quietly become consultancies, that distinction is the one to press us on. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic Observability and Governance
jobs.description_text: YOUR MISSION We're seeking a Principal Product Manager to help advance our Agentic Automation vision by giving enterprises the means to see, trust, and govern every agent they run, whether it runs on UiPath or somewhere else. Your scope spans three connected areas. Traces and observability capture the end-to-end record of what an agent did, what it cost, which model and configuration it used, and why. Those traces are the single source of truth for what happens across the UiPath platform, covering agents and every service that joins our trace infrastructure. Agent identity establishes who owns an agent, who it acts for, and what it's allowed to do. Governance ties the two together, and you'll be the Agents team's bridge to UiPath's broader platform governance. Across all three, you'll help define patterns the industry is still inventing, including OpenTelemetry for agents, cross-platform trace exchange, delegated permissions for agents, and policy and audit for non-deterministic systems. This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You won't be running status meetings. You'll be deep in the product: reading traces, prototyping with coding agents, talking with customers and FDEs, and turning what you learn into crisp direction for the engineers who build it. Influence, not headcount, will be your default leverage. Your north star is simple. Every agent in production should be visible, attributable, and governable. The Senior Accountant (Corporate Close) is a newly created role supporting the execution of the company’s month-end and quarter-end corporate close, including international accounting operations. This hands-on role prepares and reviews journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules and supports foreign subsidiary close, FX translation, intercompany accounting, inventory and cost accounting, fixed assets, and equity and stock-based compensation in accordance with US GAAP. The Senior Accountant will combine solid technical accounting knowledge with strong attention to detail and a willingness to take ownership of assigned areas of the general ledger. This position may also provide guidance or informal mentorship to staff accountants. The successful candidate will thrive in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment and bring a hands-on approach to their work. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys being in the office and working closely with teammates in support of the broader team goals. The Finance IT Systems team is responsible for the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of enterprise finance platforms, billing systems, and related business applications. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.location_raw: Redwood City, California; San Diego, California · Tysons, Virginia
jobs.description_text: Senior Product Manager, Commercial Video IoT Devices The Role Alarm.com is looking for a senior product manager to lead development of key commercial video hardware products, starting with our PoE camera line. This is a hands-on product role for someone who can operate at both the architecture level and the last-10%-of-the-product level. You will own products across hardware, firmware, and software over their full lifecycle. That means working with ODM partners on platform and component choices, making product and specification tradeoffs, pressure-testing real-world installation workflows, and driving the software and firmware work needed to deliver a complete product experience. Day to day, this role can range from reviewing chipset options with a hardware partner, to tearing down a prototype to evaluate a mechanical constraint, to prioritizing launch-critical software issues with engineering. You should care as much about system architecture as you do about the details that determine whether a product actually feels finished in the field: accessory quality, LED behavior, cable routing, installation flow, and overall polish. This role is a strong fit for product managers who have gone deep on hardware and embedded systems, or for hardware, embedded, or systems engineers who want to move into product. jobs.description_text: Alarm.com is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions across a wide range of cutting-edge technologies that provide a unified, connected service to millions of residential and commercial properties in the US and abroad. We are looking for a talented and passionate senior RF/EMC engineer to join the Device Engineering team and help us define the future of the Internet-of-Things for residential and commercial properties by creating and integrating devices including security panels, networking gateways, and video cameras. You will be working with a team of talented engineers across a diverse set of technological backgrounds to design devices, build and manufacture hardware, architect and implement software, and collaborate in an agile and fast-paced environment. You will own the RF design and EMC compliance of multi-radio devices at our Tysons, Virginia headquarters: cellular (LTE, Cat-M, NB-IoT, RedCap), Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LoRa, and sub-GHz radios in security cameras, panels, sensors, and life-safety devices, often in small plastic enclosures next to cameras and switching power supplies. You will also mentor junior RF/EMC engineers on the team. Responsibilities: Own the RF design and performance of assigned products, from requirements through certification and production.
